title: Append
prompt: Start with an empty array. Add a to the end, then b. Return the array. append_two(1, 2) is [1, 2].
hints: append adds one item to the end.

docs.name: list.append(value)
docs.what: Adds value to the end of the array. Returns nothing.

solution:
func append_two(a, b):
	var items = []
	items.append(a)
	items.append(b)
	return items
